newsitem.title: USA: Intraday CSCE world sugar lower, rangebound.
newsitem.headline: Intraday CSCE world sugar lower, rangebound.

text.p: CSCE world sugar futures were trading lower at midsession on trade selling in the March/May spread, floor sources said.
Speculative rolling of March contracts into May helped push the spread to one point, where it stood at 1145 EST.
Some buying in May on a scale-down basis, and light trade buying on dips was also noted.
Activity was thin as the spot-March contract continued to back away from resistance at 10.70 cents, where fund short covering is expected to emerge.
Friday's March options expiry may be keeping activity light, a trader said.
Volume was estimated at only 6,211 lots at 1100 EST.
At 1145 EST, the March contract was down 0.05 to 10.55, having ranged from 10.58 to 10.52 cents. The back months were trading 0.04 to 0.01 lower.
The March/May spread was trading at 0.02 cent compared with 0.06 cent on Friday's close.
Open interest in the March contract stood at 54,595 lots as of Friday's close, down 2,136 lots from the previous day. About three weeks remain until the contract expires.
